openai-chat.note: OpenAI Chat Completions dialect (the de-facto standard other servers speak)

access.login_hint: Log in again: run lm15.auth.login_xai() (SuperGrok / X Premium subscription auth)

xai.note: xAI Grok (Chat Completions dialect; XAI_API_KEY or subscription OAuth)

access.login_hint: Log in again: run `claude` and use /login (Claude subscription auth)
access.system_prefix: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.

claude-code.note: Claude subscription through the local `claude` CLI login

access.login_hint: Log in again: run `codex login` (ChatGPT subscription auth)

openai-codex.note: ChatGPT subscription through the local `codex` CLI login

deepseek.note: DeepSeek (Chat Completions dialect; thinking mode on by default)

deepseek-anthropic.note: DeepSeek over the Anthropic Messages wire (same key as `deepseek`; no model listing)

zai.note: Z.AI GLM (Chat Completions dialect; general endpoint, not the Coding Plan)

moonshotai.note: Moonshot AI Kimi (Chat Completions dialect; kimi-k3 takes reasoning effort low|high|max, kimi-k2.6 takes effort off; Moonshot's docs call the key MOONSHOT_API_KEY — read after MOONSHOTAI_API_KEY)

moonshotai-responses.note: Moonshot AI Kimi over the Responses wire (same key as `moonshotai`; kimi-k3 only; stateless — reasoning replays as summary text; web_search built-in)

moonshotai-anthropic.note: Moonshot AI Kimi over the Anthropic Messages wire (same key as `moonshotai`, bearer token; kimi-k3 only)

meta.note: Meta Model API — Muse Spark over the Responses wire (reasoning replay, web_search), plus Files, Images (muse-image-1.0) and Models; Meta's docs call the key MODEL_API_KEY — export it as META_API_KEY

meta-chat.note: Meta Model API over the Chat Completions wire (same key as `meta`; no cross-turn reasoning)

meta-anthropic.note: Meta Model API over the Anthropic Messages wire (same key as `meta`; bearer token)

azure.note: Azure OpenAI v1 Responses wire ({resource}.openai.azure.com; model = deployment name; api-key or Entra token)

azure-chat.note: Azure OpenAI v1 Chat Completions wire (same resource; also Foundry-sold models such as DeepSeek and Grok)

azure-anthropic.note: Claude in Microsoft Foundry ({resource}.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic; api-key, x-api-key or Entra token)

aws-anthropic.note: Claude Platform on AWS (Anthropic-operated; SigV4 or ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY; needs AWS_REGION and ANTHROPIC_AWS_WORKSPACE_ID)

bedrock-anthropic.note: Claude in Amazon Bedrock (bedrock-mantle, Opus 4.7 and later; SigV4 or AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK; needs AWS_REGION)

bedrock-chat.note: Amazon Bedrock over the OpenAI Chat Completions wire (bedrock-runtime /openai/v1; SigV4 or AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)

bedrock-mantle-chat.note: Amazon Bedrock Chat Completions on bedrock-mantle (un-versioned ids, GET /v1/models; SigV4 or AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)

vertex.note: Gemini on Google Cloud (Agent Platform); ADC chain; needs GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION defaults to global

vertex-express.note: Agent Platform express mode: GOOGLE_API_KEY as ?key=, no project or location

vertex-anthropic.note: Claude on Google Cloud (rawPredict; model in the path, anthropic_version in the body)

rules.note: OpenAI GPT family (Responses API; use openai-chat: for Chat Completions)
Google Gemma open models, served by the Gemini API (live /models listing 2026-09-01)
Google image models on the Gemini API (live /models listing 2026-09-01)
xAI Grok family (XAI_API_KEY or subscription OAuth)
